name: Soveria Mannelli (Italy)
description: Quartered blue and white, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Soveria Mannelli (crossed swords above a flame on blue) within branches, with the name SOVERIA MANNELLI on a scroll.
history: Municipal flag of Soveria Mannelli, a comune in Calabria; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Soveria Mannelli arms — crossed swords above a flame on blue, crowned, within branches
